text: Your coin just pumped. And the launchpad paid you creator fees. In real stocks.
Now the question every creator gets: what about the holders who stayed?
With yo-yo, you pay them. Automatically. Here is how.
Open the dashboard, connect your wallet, and pick your coin. yo-yo finds the ones you created.
On the canvas, route the fees. Say, seventy percent to holders. The rest to you, a buyback, a treasury.
Turn on the record date. Wallets that held longer earn more. A sniper who bought five minutes ago gets nothing.
Choose what they receive. NVDA, in kind. Or any coin on Robinhood Chain, by contract address.
Save. Every closing bell, the fees go out, and a receipt lands in your Telegram group.
Real holders. Really paid. yo dash yo dot dev.
